newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF says to act properly on wild forex moves.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF says to act properly on wild forex moves.

text.p: Japan will continue to act appropriately against excessive fluctuations in the currency market, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said on Friday.

"Excessive weakness in the yen as well as excessive strength in the yen is undesirable. We will deal with those moves appropriately," Mitsuzuka told a key budget committee of the Upper House of parliament.

Mitsuzuka also said that the government must not verbally intervene in the stock market and let the market decide its level for itself. But the government will be watching movements in stock prices with interest, he said.
